params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$wt="$env:USERPROFILE\mhw-mods-pr90-integration"
if(-not (Test-Path $wt)){ throw 'PR90 worktree missing' }
Push-Location $wt
try {
  $conflicts=@(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)
  if($conflicts.Count -ne 1 -or $conflicts[0] -ne '_AGENT_CONTEXT/CURRENT_REVISION.json'){ throw "unexpected conflicts: $($conflicts -join ',')" }
  git checkout --theirs -- _AGENT_CONTEXT/CURRENT_REVISION.json
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'failed to take current-main CURRENT_REVISION as resolution base' }
  $py = @'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("_AGENT_CONTEXT/CURRENT_REVISION.json")
d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
d["workingBranch"] = "agent/game-profile-id-containment-v8.8.5-reconcile"
d["currentVersion"] = "8.8.5"
d["nextMilestone"] = "Verify the current-main-reconciled v8.8.5 game-profile ID containment candidate with scripts/Verify-Release.ps1, then obtain focused path-containment review and hosted Windows evidence before integration."
d["status"] = "v8.8.5-current-main-reconciled-verification-pending"
d["candidateSourceCommit"] = "e25b68da3685585fafa8809eedb452a04ea99c82"
d["verificationScopeNote"] = ("Canonical v8.8.4 updater/publication evidence from current main is preserved: source 5abe40304dfcb48f96e750bd7da3d0075315625b passed hosted Windows Release Gate 36541891969 (25/25), functions 748/748, updater build 61, immutable updater-main-61. PR #90 game-profile containment previously passed local Verify-Release 25/25 on its older base, but that evidence is stale after current-main reconciliation. Exact reconciled-candidate verification is pending and must be recorded before promotion.")
new_changes = [
    "2026-09-29 v8.8.5 current-main reconciliation: preserve canonical updater-main-61 publication/evidence and post-updater support dispositions while carrying forward only PR #90 game-profile ID containment production/tests.",
    "2026-09-28 v8.8.5 game-profile ID containment: reject noncanonical persisted/upserted profile IDs, enforce generic-game workspace/state lexical containment before directory creation, and add hostile traversal/separator/casing regressions."
]
old = d.get("candidateChanges") or []
for item in reversed(new_changes):
    if item not in old:
        old.insert(0, item)
d["candidateChanges"] = old
p.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
'@
  $py | python -
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'CURRENT_REVISION reconciliation script failed' }
  git add _AGENT_CONTEXT/CURRENT_REVISION.json
  git diff --check
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'git diff --check failed' }
  Write-Output 'STAGED_STAT_BEGIN'; git diff --cached --stat; Write-Output 'STAGED_STAT_END'
  git commit -m "Reconcile v8.8.5 profile containment onto current main"
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'merge commit failed' }
  Write-Output "MERGE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  git status --short --branch
} finally { Pop-Location }
